notes.title: Doodle Factory Special Machine Update
notes.notes:
What’s new?

Special Machines
These Special Machines are available from Tier 2 and above boards. These are placed upon the generation of the board. It will assist you on your automation!

Endgame Upgrades
Hub can be upgraded indefinitely to multiply the resources you receive.
Unlock the Monolith Board to enhance the endgame experience.

Quality of Life

 You can now hover on the storage of the resources to view how much you gain per second of that resource.
 Windowed mode can now be resized at your own resolution
 Number notation is now used for the resources
        k = 1,000
        m = 1,000,000
        b = 1,000,000,000
 Controls are now shown on the lower left of the screen
 Confirmation screen on deleting a board

Bug fixes

 Bug fix on moving and switching boards causes big spike in FPS
 Tutorial jump fix on trying to switch the board at the beginning
 And so on…


Join our discord to give suggestions and to report some bugs.
